summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on setting Time To Live (TTL) parameters for session data in the sandbox environment to manage storage capacity. It was determined that TTL should be applied to both `device_session_agg_4` and general session tables, retaining data for six months.

Specific technical guidance was provided regarding the correct syntax for implementing the TTL using date functions (e.g., `toYYYYMM(session_start_date) + 6`) to ensure proper partitioning and efficient cleanup, preventing unnecessary filtering or merging operations.
decisions: Implement a Time To Live (TTL) of six months on the `device_session_agg_4` table in the sandbox environment.
Apply TTL settings to general session tables as well.
Use the syntax `toYYYYMM(session_start_date) + 6` for accurate date-based partitioning when setting TTL.
